evidence_items.explanation: The filing defines run-rate revenue using trailing 28-day consumption fees multiplied by 13 plus monthly subscription fees multiplied by 12. That explains the disclosed measure, but does not establish the unspecified peculiar practice or its alleged role in the earlier growth.
